set system host-name NATA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set routing-instances VRF1.explanation: This command fragment configures a routing instance named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing for separate routing tables and protocols within that instance.

parameters.name: routing-instance
parameters.explanation: Name of route example, e.g. net.

set firewall family inet filter ACL1 ter.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from source-address [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter ACL1 ter.command: set firewall family inet filter ACL1 term match-traffic from source-address 192.168.10.0/24
set firewall family inet filter ACL1 ter.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的匹配条件。

set firewall family inet filter ACL1.command: set firewall family inet filter ACL1
set firewall family inet filter ACL1.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term match-traffic.explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

then accept.explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.

set services nat pool NAT_POOL1.explanation: This command fragment configures a NAT pool named `[parameter1]` in Junos, defining a range of IP addresses for source or destination NAT translations.

address-netmask 255.255.255.0.explanation: Configure the subnet mask for the NAT pool.

set services nat rule NAT_RULE1.explanation: This command fragment configures a NAT (Network Address Translation) rule under the "services" hierarchy in Junos, defining parameters for address translation.

term 1.explanation: This command configures a NAT rule by defining a specific term within the rule, where `parameter1` is the rule name and `parameter2` is the term name.

then translated-source pool NAT_POOL1.explanation: Configure the conversion actions for NAT rules.
